title: Intrinsic proper/open arrows on single constant-ring module complexes
statement: For the constant-ring module operations [def-cbc-strict-constant-tower-operations, def-cbc-strict-tower-open-extension], construct the canonical open-to-direct-image map by the proper adjunction unit followed by direct image of the inverse open unit. For a clopen immersion this map is invertible and its inverse composed with the proper unit gives the component projector. The unit-normalized ordinary open base-change transpose [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-base-change] is invertible for arbitrary commutative coefficient ring B. For any commutative square k p = r i with quasi-compact open k,i and proper r,p, use the clopen pullback lift [def-cbc-strict-tower-proper-open-arrows], canonical open base change and open and inverse-image compositors to construct singleAlpha: J_i G_p -> G_r J_k on module sheaves. Descend this exact natural transformation to unbounded derived categories by localization. Define singleGamma: R_r J_i -> J_k R_p as its proper-adjunction mate [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate]. All arrows are actual constructions, with no choice of an unnormalized comparison.

source.place: Tag 0F7B, open proper case; proetale.tex Tag 09AE. The single-level constant-ring module construction and exact unbounded localization are the explicit refinement used in the strict-tower proof.

proof.text: The arbitrary-B fixed-coefficient equivalence in the strict-tower arrows proof makes module open extension fully faithful. Its unit is invertible. Ordinary open base change places G_g J_j in the essential image of J_jprime, so the counit on that object is invertible. The prescribed singleBetaInv is the extension of the pulled-back open unit and square isomorphism followed by this counit; thus singleBetaInv_isIso_general holds.

Transport the ordinary sectionwise clopen extension/direct-image isomorphism through the fixed-coefficient equivalence. Direct image is fully faithful. The canonical open-to-direct-image map is its adjunction unit on J M followed by direct image of the inverse open unit, so is invertible. Define singlePi from the proper unit and this canonical inverse. Define singleJComp by leftAdjointCompIso and singleJCongr by equality transport.

Use the proved projectedComparison constructor with canonical pullback beta, singlePi, singleJComp, equality transport and moduleGComp to define singleAlpha. Descend the natural transformation by Localization.liftNatTrans on complexes and conjugate by the exact composition factorizations. Take the mate under the two specified exact/right-derived module adjunctions. These formulas define singleDerivedAlpha and singleGamma without a data hole.

proof_origin.place: Source proof extracted from the strict-tower calculus argument; explicit module construction and adjunction normalization.

def singleGamma {V W S T : Scheme.{u}}
    (k : V ⟶ W) (r : V ⟶ S) (p : W ⟶ T) (i : S ⟶ T)
    [IsOpenImmersion k] [IsOpenImmersion i] [QuasiCompact k] [QuasiCompact i]
    [IsProper r] [IsProper p] (h : k ≫ p = r ≫ i) :
    (moduleDirectImage B r).rightDerivedFunctor ⋙ (moduleJ B i).mapDerivedCategory ⟶
      (moduleJ B k).mapDerivedCategory ⋙ (moduleDirectImage B p).rightDerivedFunctor
